title: Report
description: What an agent did once it finished: the prose at reading width, the figures beside it, the test plan and the list of what was fixed.

getBody.value:
The board now reads a drop as a path, so a tile carried across the grain wraps the node it landed on.

The measure held: prose stays at reading width while a figure takes the whole column.

rows.caption: A tile carried across the grain wraps the leaf under the pointer.
rows.drawing:
```
[ A ]   [ B ]
  └── dropped across ──┐
[ A ]   [ B over C ]
```

rows.step: Carry a tile onto a leaf from the side.
rows.expect: A new row box holds both.

rows.step: Carry the last tile out of a box.
Narrow the tile under the reading width.
rows.expect: The figure is the column wide.

rows.title: A drop across the grain wrapped the parent, not the leaf.
An empty declared box was pruned with the rest.

getBody.label: Report
getBody.hint: The prose of the report, typed here or bound to a note. Headings, lists and links work as they do in a note.

getFigures.label: Figures
getFigures.hint: One record per figure, each drawn by the widget in the figure slot.

getTestPlan.label: Test plan
getTestPlan.hint: One record per step: what to press, and what should happen when it is pressed.

getFixes.label: What was fixed
getFixes.hint: One record per fix, with the file it was made in.

getMeasure.label: Reading width, in characters
getMeasure.hint: How wide the prose is allowed to run. A figure ignores it and takes the whole tile.

getStepsPerPage.label: Test steps per page
getStepsPerPage.hint: How many steps of the test plan are drawn at once.
